environment.description: CI/CD pipeline plugin deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). Service is accessible at https://pipeline.corp.example.com. Users authenticate via corporate SSO which sets Flask session cookies with SameSite=None for cross-domain SSO compatibility. ALB has no WAF attached. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
